glossary.definition:
(A) "Public utility" has the same meaning as in section 4905.02 of the Revised Code.

(B) "Electric light company," "gas company," "natural gas company," "pipeline company," "water-works company," "sewage disposal system company," and "street railway company" have the same meanings as in section 4905.03 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4909.01 - Public utilities commission - fixation of rates definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Railroad" has the same meaning as in section 4907.02 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4909.01 - Public utilities commission - fixation of rates definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "For-hire motor carrier" has the same meaning as in section 4921.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4909.01 - Public utilities commission - fixation of rates definitions.
